description: This file declares the interface for the throttle management module in lighttpd, defining types, constants, and function prototypes related to throttle control and pool management.

methods.name: li_throttle_new
methods.description: Creates a new throttle state object.

methods.name: li_throttle_set
methods.description: Configures the throttle settings for a worker, including rate and burst size.

methods.name: li_throttle_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a throttle state object.

methods.name: li_throttle_query
methods.description: Queries the throttle state and potentially sets up notification callback.

methods.name: li_throttle_update
methods.description: Updates the throttle state to reflect used capacity.

methods.name: li_throttle_pool_acquire
methods.description: Acquires a throttle pool for use.

methods.name: li_throttle_add_pool
methods.description: Adds a throttle pool to a throttle state, returns whether it was actually added.

methods.name: li_throttle_remove_pool
methods.description: Removes a throttle pool from a throttle state.
